dimensions.name: Country
dimensions.description: Country of the risk or the legal entity (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2).

dimensions.name: Legal company
dimensions.description: Legal entity that books the transaction; each journal balances per company and currency.

dimensions.name: Line of business
dimensions.description: Line of business of the policy (e.g. MOTOR, HOME).

dimensions.name: Product
dimensions.description: Insurance product the policy was sold under.

dimensions.name: Transaction type
dimensions.description: Source transaction type (new business, endorsement, cancellation, renewal, …) after normalisation.

dimensions.name: Bank account
dimensions.description: Bank account a payment was deposited to (an identifier; any value).

dimensions.name: Banking company
dimensions.description: Legal company that owns the bank account a payment landed in; derived by lookup from BANK_ACCOUNT.

dimensions.name: Booking class
dimensions.description: A (advance, effective in a future period) or C (current); derived by the date policy (US-009).
